$doc: Seeded fault fixtures (PHASE2-PLAN 'Fixtures and calibration'). Each is the approved v2 with exactly one fault; qa/fixtures/build.mjs builds them into WORK/qa-fixtures/<id>/ and qa/fixtures/run-fixtures.mjs (hm qa fixtures) checks that the approved v2 passes every gate and that each fixture fails exactly its own gate, with the named check failing inside it. 'plan' marks the fixtures of the plan's list ('planItem' 1-13 in its order; item 7, a tinted or rescaled logo, has one fixture for each); the others are extra coverage. FU-5 added one fixture for each gate that had none (moov-at-end, foreign-frame-hashes, unlisted-asset, camouflaged-mallow, foreign-realm, washed-out-text, ballooning-cards, unemitted-cue, subframe-flood), so every gate has at least one; 'render': true runs the determinism re-render for that fixture.
